name: Link
summary: Inline text link. Always rendered as an <a>, never a Button — links navigate, buttons act. Three appearances — default (text.primary with underline-on-hover, the prose default), subtle (text.secondary, navigation flavor), and accent (text.accent, sparingly — emphasis on a single CTA inside prose). External links signal with a trailing arrow / ExternalLink glyph and rel='noreferrer noopener'.

appearance.description: default: text.primary + underline-on-hover. subtle: text.secondary + underline-on-hover. accent: text.accent + underline-on-hover (reserved emphasis).

external.description: When true, renders rel='noreferrer noopener' + target='_blank' + a trailing ExternalLink glyph. Announces 'opens in new tab' to SR.

underline.description: always: prose / footer / docs. hover: app body (default). none: navigation contexts (Navbar items, Breadcrumbs).

size.description: inherit takes the parent's font-size (prose default). sm/md/lg map to type.label.sm/md/lg.

asChild.description: Forwards to a routing primitive (e.g. Next Link, React Router Link) via slot.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next link
Shift+F10 (or context menu) - open browser context menu (copy link, etc.)
rules: Always an <a> with href. JS-only navigation (router.push) is wired via asChild or onClick on a routed Link; never use role='link' on a div.
external=true renders rel='noreferrer noopener' and target='_blank'. The trailing ExternalLink icon is announced to SR via aria-label='Opens in new tab'.
Link purpose must be inferable in context. 'Click here' is forbidden — link text must describe the destination.
Underline is the WCAG 1.4.1 fallback for users with color-vision differences when a link sits next to non-link text. Use underline='always' inside prose paragraphs.
Focus ring per AGENTS.md hard rule 11 — outline + box-shadow.

do: Always link text describes the destination — 'See the docs', not 'click here'.
Use external=true for outbound links to clearly distinguish them from internal nav.
Use appearance='accent' sparingly — at most one accent link per surface, reserved for the primary inline CTA.
Pair external link icon with the brand stroke (text.tertiary at rest, text.primary on hover).
dont: Don't use Link for actions ('Delete', 'Submit'). Use Button.
Don't use 'click here' — link text must describe the destination.
Don't paint links in the accent green by default. The default appearance is text.primary + underline.
Don't strip the underline from in-prose links (underline='none' is for navigation contexts only).
Don't render external links without rel='noreferrer noopener' — security + privacy regression.

changelog.note: Initial Link contract. Three appearances (default / subtle / accent). External-link safety. Three underline modes.
